example/dev.spec:
description = "Everyday interactive dev shell"
exec = "bash --noprofile -l"
loadout_mode = "open"
packages = ["base", "mermaid-cli", "emacs", "emacs-config-dev1", "kittyview", "claude-code", "less"]
type = "session"
volumes = ["dev"]

[network]
mode = "own_ip"

[network.egress]
allow_dns_hosts = ["github.com", "api.anthropic.com"]

[upstream]
branch = "main"
build_cache_url = "https://cache.gominimal.dev"
commit = "defad31c69130df153e9263cb1e4dca96b3e2994"
repo_url = "https://github.com/gominimal/pkgs"

example/render-diagrams.spec:
description = "Render the mermaid diagrams in architecture.md to SVG"
exec = "mmdc -i architecture.md -o out/"
loadout_mode = "sealed"
packages = ["base", "mermaid-cli"]
type = "task"

[[file_exports]]
path = "out/"

[[file_imports]]
path = "architecture.md"

[network]
mode = "none"

[upstream]
branch = "main"
build_cache_url = "https://cache.gominimal.dev"
commit = "defad31c69130df153e9263cb1e4dca96b3e2994"
repo_url = "https://github.com/gominimal/pkgs"

builtin/build.constraints:
exec_enabled = false
loadout_mode = "sealed"
pty_enabled = false

[nesting]
allowed = false

builtin/container-build.constraints:
exec_enabled = false
loadout_mode = "sealed"
pty_enabled = false

[nesting]
allowed = false
